input: I'm CUS-0002. CloudServe charged me twice on September 8 (TX-0201). How many days do I have to dispute it as a duplicate charge?

additional_metadata.contradicts: C-11: support believes every dispute has 60 days; the help page in C-12 says 120. The engine settles both: duplicate_charge 60, fraud_card_not_present 120. Both complaints go into the set (CMP-11, CMP-12).
additional_metadata.why_this_level: the expected answer is a number of days, not a sentence: exact text equality (level 1) fails on any phrasing, a bare '60' (level 3 contains) also matches '600' or a date, so a level 3 regex anchored on the unit 'day(s)' is the cheapest check that still catches 90 or 120
